name: Is it possible for a homeowner to manage the permit process themselves, or is it better to use a general contractor like AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: Is it possible for a homeowner to manage the permit process themselves, or is it better to use a general contractor like AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: While a homeowner can technically manage the permit process, it is often a complex and time-consuming undertaking, especially for substantial renovations. This involves understanding local building codes, preparing detailed architectural and engineering plans, navigating municipal department requirements, and responding to review comments. Choosing AKN Design Group means our team handles permit coordination entirely, leveraging our expertise and established relationships to ensure accuracy and efficiency. This approach reduces homeowner stress, prevents costly delays due to errors or omissions, and ensures compliance, which is a core part of our commitment to a seamless, managed renovation process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Managing permits yourself is complex; a general contractor like AKN Design Group streamlines the process by handling all submissions and liaising with authorities, saving homeowners time and stress.
